note: days_to_mature, season, yield_amount and yields_item_id are NOT required on growth-group stage manifests (crop_sprout/growing/mature): for a crop group that data is owned by the group manifest's growth.rules (see growth_group.schema.json) and must not be repeated per stage. They stay valid (and are still used) on standalone items such as seed_*.

season.note: spring, summer, fall, winter, or year_round (greenhouse-friendly crops). '' for non-crop items (raw seeds still get a season - it's when they CAN be planted).

yield_amount.note: units produced when harvested. Only meaningful on crop_mature_* items - 0 for sprout/growing stages, seeds, and any crop species that doesn't have a mature growth-stage item yet. Only the mature stage is harvestable at all; growth itself (seed -> sprout -> growing -> mature) is handled by the growth_groups system in kit_config.json, not this schema.

yields_item_id.note: the catalog item id produced by harvesting this crop, once mature - either a food_* item directly (carrot, potato, pumpkin, strawberry, tomato all go straight to food) or an ingredient_* item needing further processing (corn, wheat, sunflower, cotton, herb - see ingredients.schema.json's processing_method/next_item_id chain, e.g. wheat mills into flour before it can become bread). ONLY set on crop_mature_* items, same restriction as yield_amount - '' on seeds, sprouts, growing stages, and any species without a mature item yet.
